hypotheses.text: If left-back Kofi Asante-Rhys had been 1 m closer, his pressure would have reduced Ondo’s shooting angle and likely lowered the chance-to-score compared with 5.9%.

If right midfielder Idris Calloway had been 3 m closer, cutting off space and a passing option, Ondo’s shot quality and chance-to-score would have decreased, showing nearer midfield support could have prevented the goal.
If right-back Noah Fairley had been 5 m closer, increased defensive cover on that side would have constrained Ondo’s run and shooting corridor and meaningfully reduced the chance-to-score.
